name: Cis-(+/-)-3-allylfentanyl
summary: 3-Allylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of fentanyl.

pharmacology.text: 3-Allylfentanyl has effects similar to fentanyl, although it is only 0.13x-0.14x as potent by weight.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs vary based on strength and are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is known from research on fentanyl analogues.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要出現在芬太尼類似物的研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要出现在芬太尼类似物的研究中。

fact.en: Fentanyl, its parent, was first made by Paul Janssen in Belgium in 1960. Chemists have since made hundreds of variants, like this one with an allyl group added to its piperidine ring.
fact.zh: 它的母體芬太尼在 1960 年由比利時的保羅·楊森首次合成。此後化學家又製造了數百種變體，例如這種在哌啶環上加了烯丙基的化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体芬太尼在 1960 年由比利时的保罗·杨森首次合成。此后化学家又制造了数百种变体，例如这种在哌啶环上加了烯丙基的化合物。
